andros-bonefish.alt: Illustration: two distant fly anglers on a pale sand flat beside mangroves at Andros, Bahamas.

belize-reef.alt: Illustration: a small fishing boat over blue reef water beside a sandy palm cay in Belize.

delta-clearwater-grayling.alt: Illustration: Late August morning. A distant fly angler seen from behind on a low grassy bank of the crystal-clear spring-fed Delta Clearwater River. Transparent water reveals gravel and aquatic plants; low interior Alaska spruce and birch forest, soft early yellow leaves. Flat river corridor, no invented towering glacier.

eglinton-river.alt: Illustration: a distant fly angler beside the clear Eglinton River beneath beech forest and Fiordland mountains, New Zealand.

finland-ice-fishing.alt: Illustration: two ice anglers on a snow-covered lake beside a boreal forest, Finland.

g-united-states-lower-sacramento-river.alt: Illustration: a drift boat on the Lower Sacramento River beside gravel bars and golden oak foothills, California.

g-united-states-rogue-river.alt: Illustration: a drift boat on the Rogue River below rocky canyon slopes and evergreen forest, Oregon.

gangwon-streams.alt: Illustration: a distant fly angler beside a clear boulder-lined stream below forested mountains, Gangwon, South Korea.

hokkaido-char.alt: Illustration: a fly angler in a clear summer stream beneath birch woods and forested hills, northern Hokkaido.

keys-flats.alt: Illustration: a small poling skiff among turquoise channels, sand flats and mangrove islands in the Florida Keys.

keys-offshore.alt: Illustration: a charter boat with trolling rods on blue Atlantic water beyond the low Florida Keys.

lower-zambezi-tiger.alt: Illustration: a guided fishing boat on the Lower Zambezi beside sandbanks and acacia trees beneath a distant escarpment.

na-us-fl-002.alt: Illustration: a bass boat beside reeds and aquatic vegetation on the flat waters of Lake Okeechobee, Florida.

na-us-ga-001.alt: Illustration: a bass boat on Lake Lanier beside red-clay banks and wooded Georgia hills.

na-us-ga-002.alt: Illustration: a fly angler on the Chattahoochee bank beside mist, rocks and green woodland below Buford Dam, Georgia.

na-us-nc-002.alt: Illustration: a charter boat with trolling rods on Atlantic water, with the Outer Banks faintly visible on the horizon, North Carolina.

na-us-sc-001.alt: Illustration: a flats skiff beside spartina marsh, oyster banks and live oaks in Charleston, South Carolina.

na-us-sc-002.alt: Illustration: an angler on a skiff beside oyster bars and saltmarsh at Port Royal Sound near Beaufort, South Carolina.

na-us-tx-002.alt: Illustration: a bass boat among standing timber and flooded stumps at Lake Fork, Texas.

northern-patagonia-trout.alt: Illustration: a drift boat on a clear Patagonian river with golden grasses and the Andes behind, Argentina.

quepos-offshore.alt: Illustration: a charter boat on Pacific water with forested coastal hills behind Quepos, Costa Rica.

rio-negro-peacock.alt: Illustration: an angler on a small boat beside a sandbar and dense forest on the Rio Negro, Brazil.

rocky-mountain-alpine.alt: Illustration: Late summer morning, a distant rear-view fly angler on a rocky alpine lake bank reached by hiking. Clear cold lake, granite talus, sparse subalpine conifers and rugged Colorado Rocky Mountain peaks, small remnant snow patches well above water.

situk-coho-river.alt: Illustration: an angler on a gravel bank beside the Situk River, with spruce forest and misty foothills near Yakutat, Alaska.

soca-fly-fishing.alt: Illustration: a fly angler in clear turquoise water below limestone peaks in the Soča Valley, Slovenia.

tanana-glacial-system.alt: Illustration: Summer evening. A small plain aluminum river fishing boat beside a quiet tributary mouth in the Tanana drainage. Distant rear-view angler casting spinning tackle. Silty blue-gray glacial main river meets clearer tributary water, broad gravel bars, interior Alaska spruce forest and distant Alaska Range.

tasmania-great-lake.alt: Illustration: a shore fly angler beside a broad lake with dolerite stones and highland tussock grass, Yingina, Tasmania.

texas-inshore-redfish.alt: Illustration: a distant skiff beyond saltmarsh and sandy flats in a Texas coastal bay.

top-end-barramundi.alt: Illustration: a small fishing boat on a tidal creek beside pandanus and mangroves, Northern Territory Top End.

yakutat-halibut.alt: Illustration: Summer morning in Yakutat Bay. Small unbranded cabin charter boat in the middle distance, two tiny anglers bottom fishing over the rail, rods pointing down toward deep slate-blue water. Vast snowy Saint Elias peaks and glacier-influenced coast behind, evergreen shoreline far away.
